speed.name: speed
speed.description: Adjust playback speed for the current track
speed.no_voice: ❌ You must be in a voice channel to use this command!
speed.same_voice_channel: ❌ You must be in the same voice channel as the bot!
speed.filters_not_supported: ❌ This player does not support speed adjustment!
speed.current_description:
Current speed: **{speed}%** ({speedValue}x)

💡 Use `{prefix}speed <value>` to change speed (0.25-2.0)
Use `{prefix}speed reset` to reset to normal speed
speed.usage_examples:
• `{prefix}speed 1.5` - Set speed to 1.5x (150%)
• `{prefix}speed 0.75` - Set speed to 0.75x (75%)
• `{prefix}speed reset` - Reset to normal speed (1.0x)

**Range:** 0.25x (25%) to 2.0x (200%)
speed.invalid_value:
❌ Invalid speed value! Please enter a number between 0.25 and 2.0, or use `reset`.
Example: `{prefix}speed 1.5`
speed.set:
⚡ Playback speed set to **{speed}%** ({speedValue}x) for this session
🎵 {title}
speed.reset:
⚡ Playback speed reset to normal (100% / 1.0x) for this session
🎵 {title}
speed.already_reset: ✅ Playback speed is already at normal (100% / 1.0x)
speed.session_active: Speed setting is active for all tracks in this session
speed.error: ❌ An error occurred while adjusting playback speed!

announce.name: announce
announce.description: View or toggle track announcement when new track starts
announce.current_description: Track announcement sends a message to the text channel when a new track starts playing.
announce.enabled: ✅ **Enabled** - Bot will announce when new tracks start
announce.disabled: ❌ **Disabled** - Bot will not announce new tracks
announce.enabled_description: The bot will send an embed message to the text channel whenever a new track starts playing, showing track information and details.
announce.disabled_description: The bot will not send any messages when tracks start. This reduces channel spam but you won't see track information automatically.
announce.toggle_instruction:
Use `{prefix}announce on` to enable track announcements
Use `{prefix}announce off` to disable track announcements
announce.enabled_message: The bot will now announce when new tracks start playing.
announce.disabled_message: The bot will no longer announce when tracks start playing.
announce.invalid_value: ❌ Invalid value! Use `on` or `off` to toggle track announcements.
announce.error: ❌ An error occurred while updating track announcement setting!

247mode.name: 247mode
247mode.description: View or toggle 24/7 mode (bot stays in voice channel even when queue is empty)
247mode.current_description: 24/7 mode allows the bot to stay in the voice channel even when the queue is empty.
247mode.enabled: ✅ **Enabled** - Bot will stay in voice channel when queue is empty
247mode.disabled: ❌ **Disabled** - Bot will leave voice channel when queue is empty
247mode.enabled_description: The bot will remain in the voice channel even after all tracks finish playing. This is useful for radio stations or continuous music playback.
247mode.disabled_description: The bot will automatically leave the voice channel when the queue becomes empty. This is the default behavior.
247mode.toggle_instruction:
Use `{prefix}247mode on` to enable 24/7 mode
Use `{prefix}247mode off` to disable 24/7 mode
247mode.enabled_message: The bot will now stay in the voice channel even when the queue is empty.
247mode.disabled_message: The bot will automatically leave the voice channel when the queue becomes empty.
247mode.invalid_value: ❌ Invalid value! Use `on` or `off` to toggle 24/7 mode.
247mode.error: ❌ An error occurred while updating 24/7 mode!

autoplay.name: autoplay
autoplay.description: View or toggle autoplay mode (AI recommendation when queue ends)
autoplay.current_description: Autoplay mode automatically plays recommended songs when the queue ends, using AI recommendations based on your listening history.
autoplay.enabled: ✅ **Enabled** - Bot will automatically play recommended songs when queue ends
autoplay.disabled: ❌ **Disabled** - Bot will stop playing when queue ends
autoplay.enabled_description: When the queue ends, the bot will automatically search for and play similar songs based on the last played track, your server's play history, and most popular tracks. This creates a continuous music experience.
autoplay.disabled_description: When the queue ends, the bot will stop playing. This is the default behavior.
autoplay.toggle_instruction:
Use `{prefix}autoplay on` to enable autoplay mode
Use `{prefix}autoplay off` to disable autoplay mode
autoplay.enabled_message: The bot will now automatically play recommended songs when the queue ends.
autoplay.disabled_message: The bot will stop playing when the queue ends.
autoplay.invalid_value: ❌ Invalid value! Use `on` or `off` to toggle autoplay mode.
autoplay.error: ❌ An error occurred while updating autoplay mode!
autoplay.recommendation_failed: ❌ Failed to find recommended song. Autoplay stopped.

djconfig.name: djconfig
djconfig.description: Configure audio filters and effects for DJ role
djconfig.current_description: Configure audio filters and effects that will be applied when DJ role users play tracks.
djconfig.config_instruction:
Use `{prefix}djconfig <filter> <on|off>` to toggle filters

Available filters:
• `bassboost` - Increase bass frequencies
• `nightcore` - Speed up and pitch up
• `lofi` - Slow down with lo-fi effect
• `vaporwave` - Slow down significantly with vaporwave effect
• `volume-normalization` - Normalize volume levels
• `8d` - 8D audio rotation effect
djconfig.enabled_message: **{filter}** filter has been enabled. It will be applied when DJ role users play tracks.
djconfig.invalid_value: ❌ Invalid value! Use `on` or `off` to toggle filters.
djconfig.invalid_filter: ❌ Invalid filter! Use `{prefix}djconfig` to see available filters.
djconfig.no_permission: ❌ You need **Manage Server** permission to use this command!
djconfig.error: ❌ An error occurred while updating DJ audio configuration!

djrole.name: djrole
djrole.description: View or set DJ role for vote skip bypass
djrole.current_description: DJ role allows users to skip tracks immediately without voting.
djrole.no_role_set: ❌ No DJ role is set. Users will need to vote to skip tracks.
djrole.role_not_found: ❌ Role not found! Please mention a role or provide a valid role ID.
djrole.set_instruction:
Use `{prefix}djrole <role mention or role ID>` to set a DJ role.
Use `{prefix}djrole none` to remove the DJ role.
djrole.set_description:
DJ role has been set to: {role}

Users with this role can skip tracks immediately without voting.
djrole.removed_description: DJ role has been removed. All users will now need to vote to skip tracks.
djrole.error: ❌ An error occurred while updating DJ role!

leaderboard.name: leaderboard
leaderboard.title: 🏆 Leaderboards
leaderboard.help:
Available leaderboards:
• `dj` or `requesters` - Top DJs (most requests)
• `listeners` - Top listeners (most listening time)
• `tracks` or `hits` - Top tracks (most played)

Periods: `week`, `month`, `all` (default: all)

Example: `{prefix}leaderboard dj month`
